_readme: Orientation anchors for the map. Every entry carries its own source and a
`confirmed` flag; anything with confirmed=false renders with a '?' and is listed
in the map's 'needs confirmation' block rather than being quietly published.
anchor=true  -> stays on screen in every frame of the reveal sequence, so viewers
never lose their bearings when the map zooms into a phase.
county address point   Bay County Basic_Layers/MapServer/0 - public record
site plan              read visually off the builder's published site plan
aerial                 position read off public aerial imagery

landmarks.name: Town Square Amenity
note: One point, two stories. Karen confirmed the Bandshell as the Town Center
anchor, and it is also the origin of the live-music noise. So the
'how far to the Town Center' distance and the 'can I hear the band' ring
share a centre: the closer you are, the more you get and the more you hear.
The amenity core is built around it — Fins Up! Fitness immediately north,
Latitude Bar and Chill plus Paradise Pool immediately south, the
amphitheater and Bandshell west of the main parking. It is the middle of
RETIRED CANDIDATE: 8520 Latitude Blvd (30.312154, -85.863968) is a mailing
address reference only. It sits 554 m / 0.34 mi NNE of the Bandshell and is
not the point a buyer would walk to. Do not use it as the Town Center.
